Required / video firmware

IBM EGA option ROM

The core needs this option ROM to initialize the EGA hardware. Build it directly below; the source image and final format are checked automatically.

Output profile

ega_bios.rom

16 KiB option ROM for the core’s EGA BIOS OSD slot.

SourceIBM EGA U44
FormatCPU address order
ROM signature55 AA 20
8-bit sum00h
Why this format?

The original EPROM dump has inverted address lines. The one-click source is already in CPU address order; the manual option reverses the raw dump.

Choose one / system firmware

System BIOS

Select one of the two 64 KiB BIOS images tested with this core. Both start as separate 32 KiB even and odd ROM chips; the builder interleaves their bytes into CPU address order.

Output profile

Phoenix A286 1.01

The source archive identifies this as a PhoenixBIOS for an IBM 5170 and documents its even/odd U27/U47 chip placement. It offers integrated CMOS setup, drive options and boot sequence selection.

Output64 KiB
TransformEven/odd interleave
Tested imageA286 v1.01
Checksum note

The tested Phoenix image has an 8-bit byte sum of E3h. That is its reference value. This builder does not rewrite any BIOS bytes.

Configuration

Before you boot

A few useful details

Load two files in MiSTer

Select ega_bios.rom for the EGA BIOS slot, then select your Phoenix or MR BIOS output for the PCAT BIOS slot in System & BIOS.

Direct, local processing

One-click mode fetches the reference files from 86Box and processes them in your browser. Your files are never uploaded. Manual source selection remains available if fetching is blocked.

Exact versions only

Every source and output is checked with SHA-256. A changed file or a different revision is rejected. No generic patch or checksum repair is applied.
